name: GreenLight Assist
description: Finish the job applications GreenLight prepared. Every field is filled in your own browser; you answer the check and click submit.
//host_permissions: The app origins only, so the popup/background can make credentialed API calls (host access bypasses CORS and sends the session cookie). localhost is stripped from the published build by scripts/build-extension-zip.ts --store, since only a developer running the app locally needs it and the Web Store treats a localhost grant as an unexplained permission. Job-board access comes from content_scripts matches below, which is what actually fills forms, scoped to the exact ATS hosts GreenLight supports and nothing else.
